Celtics had this one, but a couple of unfortunate moments for the big men helped Nets get it to overtime. Neemias Queta committed a foul with Boston up four. Then Mitchell Robinson missed two free throws.

Killer shot by Mikel Brown Jr, who has been terrific late, sends it to OT.
